Median first-touch on client asks was 0.27h, p90 26.9h. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive messages from any ALTR sender (2026-08-04 15:42 -> 2026-08-09 00:23); Fred's own longest gap was 7.0d (06-29 -> 07-06) and Mica Vecco has been silent 22d at export close.
